exit_warning.stop.tip.export:
Background export tasks are still running.
Exiting now will interrupt the export process and may corrupt the exported files.
exit_warning.stop.tip.export.auto_exit.t: The application will exit automatically after all export tasks are complete.
exit_warning.exception.tip:
The application encountered an unexpected error and needs to close.
Check the log for more details.
If you report this issue, please include the relevant log files.
